gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Nestled at the end of a quiet street in a fishing cabin neighborhood along a creek, Watts Bar Camp & RV is a full-service RV park and primitive campground. We are 3 minutes from the Watts Bar Dam and public park, access to both Watts Bar and Chickamauga Lakes, and the nuclear facility. We offer daily, weekly, and monthly rates.
